correctness.rationale: Length-one overlap excludes common first and final symbols; saturating disjoint two-letter prefix/suffix sets produces a unique partition Σ=A⊔B and allocation T⊂A×B. All maximal codebooks have C=[(A×A)∪T]Σ^{n−4}[(B×B)∪((A×B)∖T)] and size q^{n−4}(a²+t)(b²+ab−t). In u=ab−t the scaled objective (aq−u)(b²+u) is a concave quadratic. The golden-ratio threshold ρ=(3−√5)/2 and rational comparison exclude interior optimizers for q≥8; q6 and q7 are checked directly, and q≤5 completely enumerated. Reverse symmetry yields two rectangular orientations q≥6, while q4,5 admit listed nonrectangular exceptions. Independent exhaustive parametric enumeration q=2..35 reproduced all optimizer classes, and supplied prefix-set direct enumeration corroborates small-q maxima. This does not extrapolate finite search to arbitrary q; analytic bounds do.
